# Saleh Ahmad

> Certified accountant (ACPA) and QuickBooks specialist offering online bookkeeping, payroll, tax preparation and QuickBooks services to businesses in the United States and worldwide. Based in Weatherford, Texas, USA, serving clients across Texas, the US and worldwide online, with 38+ years of experience in accounting and finance.

## Services

- **Accounting system setup** (https://saleh.selawii.com/accounting-system-setup/): a complete accounting system set up for the business: separate business banking, QuickBooks, a chart of accounts built around sales channels and products, inventory tracking, internal controls and approvals, a written weekly/monthly/quarterly bookkeeping routine, a budget and KPIs, and clear Excel reports (with routine updates automated where the software allows).
- **Bookkeeping** (https://saleh.selawii.com/bookkeeping/): every bank and card transaction recorded and reconciled to statements; payables and receivables; a monthly profit and loss statement, balance sheet and cash flow statement.
- **Payroll** (https://saleh.selawii.com/payroll/): salaries and wages processed accurately and on time using QuickBooks Payroll, with records kept ready for year-end.
- **Tax preparation and planning** (https://saleh.selawii.com/tax-preparation/): returns prepared from clean books, deductions claimed, filings kept compliant. Uses TurboTax.
- **QuickBooks setup, cleanup and training** (https://saleh.selawii.com/quickbooks/): QuickBooks Online and Desktop setup and customization, catch-up and cleanup of messy files, staff training, and Point of Sale.
- **Also available:** cost accounting and budgeting, internal audit and internal controls (IAS/IFRS), Islamic finance and Zakat accounting.

## How working together goes

1. Intro call about the business, its software, and where the books stand.
2. Past records reviewed and corrected; QuickBooks set up to match how the business runs.
3. Monthly close: transactions reconciled, statements delivered, payroll and tax handled on schedule.

## Experience

- 2024 to now: independent accountant with his own online practice, serving clients worldwide.
- 2011 to 2023: Financial Manager, Al-Ashegaa Real Estate, Amman, Jordan.
- 2001 to 2011: Financial Manager, MAZEN, Inc., Texas, USA. Achieved over $2 million in cost savings.
- 1997 to 2000: Chief Accountant, Paradise Fine Food, Inc., Toronto, Canada.
- 1995 to 1997: Administration and Financial Manager, Lanka Trading Co., Hatyai, Thailand.
- 1986 to 1995: Internal Auditor and Accountant, Zakat House, Kuwait.

Has served 100+ clients across 15+ industries and worked in 6 countries.

## Credentials

- Arab Certified Professional Accountant (ACPA), 2010
- CIMA Islamic Finance Diploma, 2012
- Advanced Excel Expert Certification, Microsoft, 2013
- Zakat Accounting Diploma, Kuwait Zakat House, 2020
- Master of Commerce in Accounting, Nagpur University, 1989

## Free tools

- [All calculators](https://saleh.selawii.com/calculators/)
- [Quarterly estimated tax calculator](https://saleh.selawii.com/quarterly-tax-calculator/): 2026 self-employment tax, federal income tax and safe harbor quarterly payments for 1099 income.
- [LLC vs S corp tax savings calculator](https://saleh.selawii.com/s-corp-tax-calculator/): compares self-employment tax with payroll taxes on a reasonable salary.
- [Texas sales tax calculator](https://saleh.selawii.com/texas-sales-tax-calculator/): 6.25% state rate plus up to 2% local tax.
- [Zakat calculator](https://saleh.selawii.com/zakat-calculator/): calculates zakat on personal and business wealth (cash, gold, silver, investments, receivables, inventory, minus debts due now) against the gold or silver nisab.
